title: Reset a forgotten account password
text: Open the self-service password page, choose Forgot password and answer the security questions. If the account is locked, wait 15 minutes or call the service desk. New passwords need 12 characters and cannot repeat the last five.

title: Unlock an account after too many sign-in attempts
text: Accounts lock after five wrong passwords. The service desk can unlock the account once your identity is checked. After the unlock, sign in on one device first so old saved passwords do not lock it again.

title: Get a user added to a site, wiki space or application
text: The space owner or your manager approves the request in the access portal. Name the site or space and the level needed (read or edit). Access is normally in place within one working day after approval.

title: Renew a software licence or request an access card
text: Licences are tied to your user account. Raise a request with the product name and your cost centre and the licence is assigned within a day. Access cards for new staff are ordered by the manager through the same portal and collected at reception.

title: Windows upgrade fails in the software centre
text: Restart the laptop, free at least 20 GB of disk space and run the upgrade again from the software centre. If it stops with the same error, note the error code and raise a request so the desk can push the upgrade remotely.

title: Outlook crashes or will not open after an update
text: Start Outlook in safe mode, then disable add-ins one at a time. If the problem started after an update, run the repair from the software centre. The desk can reinstall the approved version when repair does not help.

title: Install approved software through the software centre
text: Check the software centre first; most tools install without admin rights. If a tool is not listed or the install shows an error, raise a request with the product name and version and the desk will install it remotely.

title: New starter checklist and HR form
text: HR creates the employee record from the signed starter form, then IT builds the account, mailbox and laptop. Managers should raise the new starter request at least five working days before the start date and name the team and role.

title: Leaver process: closing accounts and returning equipment
text: HR enters the leaving date from the leaver form. IT disables the account at the end of the last day and mailboxes are kept for 30 days. The leaver returns the laptop, badge and any phone to the service desk.

title: Time card, leave form or HR system errors
text: Use the company network or VPN, clear the browser cache and try a private window. If a time card or leave form still shows an error, send HR the time and a screenshot. Access to the HR system for a new role is requested through the access portal.

title: Laptop will not start or the battery drains quickly
text: Hold the power button for ten seconds, unplug everything and try again with the charger only. If it still fails or the battery lasts under two hours, bring the laptop to the service desk for a swap.

title: Printer is offline or not printing
text: Check the printer shows ready and the paper tray is loaded. Remove and re-add the printer from the print portal. Cancel stuck jobs and send them again.

title: Monitor, phone or docking station not working
text: Reseat the cable at both ends and try another port. For a desk phone with no tone, check the socket and ask for the number to be moved. Faulty equipment is replaced through the hardware request form.

title: Meeting room screen, cable or camera problems
text: Switch the room panel off and on, then choose the source again. Spare cables are kept at reception. For a fault that remains, give the room name when you contact the desk.

title: Request a new project code
text: Submit the project code form with the contract or order reference, the start date and the project lead. Codes are created within one working day and appear in the timesheet tool the next morning.

title: Project workspace, pipeline and forecast access
text: The project lead adds team members to the project group. Once added, they can open the workspace and the pipeline. Rights to view or enter the forecast are requested with the project code.

title: Add someone to a distribution list or group
text: Ask the group owner to approve the request in the access portal, or raise a request naming the list. If the owner has left, the manager can ask the desk to change the owner.

title: A change or approval request is pending or stuck
text: Open the request and check who the approver is. If the approver did not get the notification, they can approve it from the approval list. The desk can reassign an approval when the approver is away.

title: How to raise a purchase order
text: Use the purchase request form and attach the quote. Requests under the team limit need manager approval; larger ones also need finance approval. The purchase order number is shown on the request once approval is complete.

title: Book goods received and check order status
text: When items arrive, attach the delivery note to the purchase order and book the receipt. For a late order, quote the purchase order number when you contact procurement.

title: Increase the size of a shared folder or mailbox
text: Shared folders and mailboxes have a fixed size. Clear old items first. If more is needed, the owner raises a request with the new size and the reason; increases up to 50 GB are approved the same day.

title: Delegate access to a shared mailbox
text: The mailbox owner raises a request naming the person and whether they may send on behalf of the team. Delegates appear in the mailbox list within an hour.

title: Permissions on a shared folder
text: Folder permissions are given by the folder owner through the access portal. Name the folder path and whether read or edit rights are needed. New members normally have access the same day.

title: Recover a deleted or overwritten file
text: Right-click the folder, choose Previous versions and pick a copy from before the change. Files deleted more than 30 days ago can be restored by the storage team from backup; give the full path and date.
